title: Power
description: Silicon power per machine: CPU/APU package watts from the kernel's RAPL energy counters (node_exporter rapl collector) and discrete-GPU watts from amdgpu's hwmon sensor. On AMD APUs and Raphael iGPUs the amdgpu sensor is the socket PPT, i.e. the same thing RAPL reports, so only chips off the CPU's internal 00:08.x bridge count as discrete GPUs. Not measured: motherboard, RAM, drives, fans, PSU losses, monitors — wall power is well above these numbers; a metering smart plug is the only way to see it. Energy integrates samples at the scraper's @scrapeIntervalSeconds@ s interval, so time a machine spends off counts as zero.

list.name: dgpu
list.query: max by(instance) (node_hwmon_power_average_watt{chip=~"0000:.*", chip!~"0000:00:08_.*"} or node_hwmon_power_watt{chip=~"0000:.*", chip!~"0000:00:08_.*"})

current.value: max by(instance) (node_hwmon_power_average_watt{chip=~"0000:.*", chip!~"0000:00:08_.*"} or node_hwmon_power_watt{chip=~"0000:.*", chip!~"0000:00:08_.*"})

panels.title: Measured power now
panels.description: CPU package plus discrete GPU, per machine.

panels.title: Energy over the selected range
panels.description: CPU package energy from the RAPL counters plus discrete-GPU watts summed per sample.

targets.expr: (sum by(instance) (increase(node_rapl_package_joules_total[$__range])) + (sum by(instance) (sum_over_time((node_hwmon_power_average_watt{chip=~"0000:.*", chip!~"0000:00:08_.*"} or node_hwmon_power_watt{chip=~"0000:.*", chip!~"0000:00:08_.*"})[$__range])) * @scrapeIntervalSeconds@ or (sum by(instance) (increase(node_rapl_package_joules_total[$__range])) * 0))) / 3.6e6

panels.title: Cost over the selected range
panels.description: Energy over the range times the price variable. Measured silicon only; the real bill is higher.

targets.expr: (sum by(instance) (increase(node_rapl_package_joules_total[$__range])) + (sum by(instance) (sum_over_time((node_hwmon_power_average_watt{chip=~"0000:.*", chip!~"0000:00:08_.*"} or node_hwmon_power_watt{chip=~"0000:.*", chip!~"0000:00:08_.*"})[$__range])) * @scrapeIntervalSeconds@ or (sum by(instance) (increase(node_rapl_package_joules_total[$__range])) * 0))) / 3.6e6 * $price

panels.title: CPU / APU package power
panels.description: RAPL package domain. On APUs this includes the integrated GPU.

panels.title: Discrete GPU power
panels.description: amdgpu hwmon on cards not behind the CPU's internal PCIe bridge.

panels.title: Daily energy
panels.description: kWh per day (UTC-aligned) of measured silicon power. Hours a machine is off count as zero.

targets.expr: (sum by(instance) (increase(node_rapl_package_joules_total[1d])) + (sum by(instance) (sum_over_time((node_hwmon_power_average_watt{chip=~"0000:.*", chip!~"0000:00:08_.*"} or node_hwmon_power_watt{chip=~"0000:.*", chip!~"0000:00:08_.*"})[1d])) * @scrapeIntervalSeconds@ or (sum by(instance) (increase(node_rapl_package_joules_total[1d])) * 0))) / 3.6e6
